items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: It's just like Dan Garber or any good orchestra, Guy LaVarro, or any of you. He sounds like them.

ctx.x: The ball of his. Yeah. The piano player teaches in public schools music. And the third sax is a music teacher too. Is that right?

I didn't know the piano player I taught to you too. But he is good. I mean, and he seems to love to play the piano. I mean, some people enjoy their nice work. And he just seems to enjoy the Indians work. He's a good. Although the music is good, I think all the musicians like it. It's only when everybody's out of step and people don't like it. The rhythm is bad. They have a lot of blue notes so I, it goes against the grain. But I find the band, with all due respect, as you know, there's good men in the band. And…
So you haven't catered to rock and roll, or you don't try for any of those changes that have come back.
